text: On the right flank near the opponent’s goal, Aiden Zielinski carries the ball forward into the final third. He sends a precise cross from about 8 metres out toward Kenji Rahman, positioned centrally about 5 metres from the goal at the Kingsmoor FC end. Rahman strikes the ball cleanly with his foot, scoring to put Westport Albion ahead 3-2. This goal crowns a sequence of quick, direct passes that began from a throw-in deep in Westport Albion’s half[#982] [#983].
